description:
The High Hazard Development Permit Area (DPA) is defined in Schedule H-1 of the District's [Official Community Plan](https://www.summerland.ca/planning-building/official-community-plan) (OCP).A note on the map which is Schedule H-1 states: "If any discrepancies exist between the boundary identifying the High Hazard Area on this map & the 1"=500' scale maps produced as part of the 1982 Golder & Associates Study of the silt bluffs, the Golder & Associates maps shall be used to define the boundary of the 'High Hazard D[e]velopment Permit Area'."
For more information on this layer, please [contact](https://www.summerland.ca/your-city-hall/contact) the Development Services Department.

The District's description above references 2 documents whose link on summerland.ca no longer resolves, so the reference is given as plain text rather than a broken link.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS object identifier assigned by the source service. Stable within one extract; not a durable key across refreshes.

table:columns.name: PermitArea
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 4 of 4 rows populated; values: Golder Red Zone.

table:columns.name: PermitType
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 4 of 4 rows populated; values: High Hazard.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, in EPSG:26911 (NAD83 / UTM zone 11N) as the District publishes it. Reproject to EPSG:4326 to join against WGS84 data.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box, the GeoParquet 1.1 covering used for spatial predicate pushdown. Derived, not upstream data.
